items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: And that same year, I recorded with Christine Cottrell up in Nashville, Tennessee.

ctx.x: Yeah. You know, he did it there. But we didn't record that with him. We recorded the answer to King... ...to Song된 stuff. ...Stług된 stuff... Stług된 stuff... Stług
high blues. And that same year, I recorded with Christine Cottrell up in Nashville, Tennessee. And I'm actually playing bass on this recording of Christine Cottrell every night in the week.
